items.source: Registers an AnthropicHttpClientBuilderCustomizer that mutates the underlying OkHttp client builder before the Anthropic clients are constructed. Use this to attach OkHttp interceptors (e.g. OAuth2 bearer-token injection), swap the dispatcher executor, or tweak any other OkHttp setting. Customizers are applied in the order they are registered, after Spring AI's own defaults, so user code wins.
items.translation: 注册一个 AnthropicHttpClientBuilderCustomizer，该自定义器会在构建 Anthropic 客户端之前修改底层的 OkHttp 客户端构建器。您可以使用此功能附加 OkHttp 拦截器（例如注入 OAuth2 访问令牌）、替换分发器执行器，或调整任何其他 OkHttp 设置。自定义器按照注册顺序依次应用，且位于 Spring AI 自身默认配置之后，因此用户代码具有最高优先级。

items.source: Sets the full list of customizers to apply, replacing any customizers registered earlier on this builder. The order of the list is preserved when invoking the customizers.
items.translation: 设置要应用的 customizers 完整列表，替换在此构建器上之前注册的任何自定义器。调用自定义器时，将保留该列表的顺序。

items.source: Sets the meter registry used to bind OkHttp connection-pool gauges (active/idle connections). Optional; when omitted, no pool gauges are registered. Auto-configuration wires the application's MeterRegistry bean here automatically.
items.translation: 设置用于绑定 OkHttp 连接池仪表（活动/空闲连接）的计量器注册表。可选；若省略，则不注册任何池仪表。自动配置会自动将应用程序的 `<code>MeterRegistry` 豆注入此处。

items.source: Sets the executor used by the underlying OkHttp dispatcher for both the sync and async clients. The caller owns the executor's lifecycle — Spring AI will not shut it down. Typical use: pass Executors.newVirtualThreadPerTaskExecutor() on Java 21+ to back HTTP dispatch with virtual threads. When omitted, an internal platform-thread executor is created and managed by the HTTP client.
items.translation: 设置底层 OkHttp 调度器在同步和异步客户端中使用的执行器。调用者需负责该执行器的生命周期管理——Spring AI 不会关闭它。典型用法：在 Java 21+ 上传入 Executors.newVirtualThreadPerTaskExecutor()，以利用虚拟线程支持 HTTP 调度。若未指定，HTTP 客户端将创建并由其内部管理的平台线程执行器。
